integrity: The finite-chain normal form is proved from explicit operations. The rank/retract formula follows from the normal form; bounded exhaustive computations provide corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: General hom-set counts for finite odd Sugihara monoids are prior work (Aguzzoli–Mordonini 2025). The newly assessed claim is rank-resolved endomorphism and retract classification; equivalent unindexed derivations remain a priority risk.
scientific_scope: Standard odd Sugihara chains S_{2m+1}, integers m>=1, with fusion, involution, implication, lattice operations and monoid identity fixed as in the result.
title: Endomorphism ranks and retracts of finite odd Sugihara chains
